issues.title: getKey(nil) when the keybinds load
issues.note: FHbindings[1] is a header with no value and core:getKey(nil) throws, so the mod's handwork stops after the first error. The Studio's shim carries a patch for it (fancy_handwork); the same file patched line by line also works.
issues.log: ERROR: ... aFancyHandwork.lua:126: attempted index: getKey of non-table
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-18)

issues.title: Clashes with O.C.D. Inventory on the inventory pane
issues.note: Both rewrite the inventory pane; the shim's patch fancy_handwork_ocd keeps both working when both are on.
